intent: fix --json --dry-run --migrate-layout: emit structured refusal instead of prose
notes: v2.9.2 regression: the 2026-08-23 `--dry-run --migrate-layout` gate at `gator-update.py:1357-1371` returns unconditionally after prose, so `gator update --json --dry-run --migrate-layout` reached the gate before the JSON branch (~107 lines further down at :1478) and emitted human text where machine consumers expect `{"schema": "gator-update-v1", ...}`. `TestMigrateDryRunGate` didn't cover the `--json` combination, so this shipped uncaught in v2.9.2.

Added `if args.json:` branch inside the gate (both copies): emits a structured refusal payload `{"schema": "gator-update-v1", "action": "migrate-layout-refused", "reason": ..., "layout": ...}` and returns 0. Exit-code parity with the prose refusal path — the payload's `action` field carries the "no work happened" signal. Prose path unchanged for interactive use.

Grepped `src/gator_command/scripts/dashboard/` for the flag combination — no consumers found, so no Dashboard code needs a `tolerate-unknown-action` change in this release. Plan §10 open question resolved.

Added 3 tests to `TestMigrateDryRunGate` in `tests/test_layout.py`: `test_dry_run_migrate_layout_with_json_returns_structured_refusal` (payload shape + `layout` field), `test_dry_run_migrate_layout_with_json_returns_zero_exit` (parity + no side-effects), `test_dry_run_migrate_layout_json_never_prints_prose` (no interactive-text leakage into stdout).
Tests: TestMigrateDryRunGate 4/4, adjacent sweep (test_layout + test_template_sync + test_hooks + test_update_entry_points + test_session_hooks) 162/162 clean.
Second commit on the shebang-fix release train (companion to `34ccfd7`). Both ride the next patch release.
